en: Black‑and‑white aerial photograph showing a complex of mid‑century modern high‑rise buildings surrounded by forest and open fields. The main complex features several rectangular slab blocks arranged around a curved entrance drive, with a tall chimney or smokestack suggesting a hospital, sanatorium, or institutional facility. Additional residential apartment blocks stand nearby along straight roads, and beyond them are patches of cultivated land and woodland. There is no visible printed caption or writing on the image side.
